description: This Java source file defines a service class for an Android Wear application that listens for connectivity changes between a wearable device and a paired phone. It leverages GoogleApiClient and Wearable APIs to monitor the presence of a capability ('find_me') and manages user notifications when the connection is lost, particularly when the wearable detects that the phone has been left behind.

classes.name: DisconnectListenerService
classes.description: An Android Wear service that monitors the connection status between the wearable device and the paired phone. It detects connectivity changes via capabilities and notifies the user when the phone is lost.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and connects the wearable API.

methods.name: onConnectedNodes
methods.description: Called when connected nodes are detected; triggers an update of notifications based on current connectivity.

methods.name: setOrUpdateNotification
methods.description: Queries the capability API for the 'find_me' capability and processes the result.

methods.name: updateFindMeCapability
methods.description: Processes the capability info to determine if connected nodes are nearby and updates notifications accordingly.

methods.name: setupLostConnectivityNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification indicating that the phone has been left behind.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback for when the GoogleApiClient connects; triggers an update of connectivity status.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback for when the GoogleApiClient connection is suspended.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup by disconnecting the GoogleApiClient when the service is destroyed.
